table.retrieve:
SELECT
	itemname= item.name,
	headerinvno=saleledger.headerinvno,   
	aliasname=max(item.customicode),   
	packingdesc=max(item.packingdesc),   
	accname = dbo.accounts.name,   
	address =max( dbo.customer.address1),   
	address2= max(dbo.customer.address2),   
	salesman = dbo.users.username,   
	saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	headerno = max(dbo.saleledger.headerno),   
	date = dbo.saleledger.date,   
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	gcode = saledetail.gcode,   
	icode = saledetail.icode,   
	batch = max(saledetail.batch),   
	expiry = max(saledetail.expiry),   
	looseqty = sum(saledetail.looseqty),   
	bonusqty = sum(saledetail.bonusqty),   
	packqty = sum(saledetail.packqty),   
	packunits= max(saledetail.packunits),   
	saleprice= max(saledetail.saleprice),   
	discperc = max(saledetail.discperc),   
	salestax = max(saledetail.salestax),   
	Id = max(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL),   
	itemflatdisc=max(saledetail.itemflatdisc),  
	posted=max(saleledger.posted),   
	balance=(select isnull(sum(v.debit - v.credit), 0) from virtualgl v
				where v.acccode=max(accounts.acccode) group by v.acccode),   
	unitsalestax = max(saledetail.unitsalestax),   
	gstperc = max(saledetail.gstperc),   
	invgstperc = saleledger.invgstperc1,   
	custTaxRegno=max(customer.salestaxregno ) ,
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno,	
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,
	dbo.saleledger.printwaranty,
	dbo.saleledger.printbatch,
	dbo.manufacturer.manfcode,
	manufacturer=max(dbo.manufacturer.name),
	custcode=max(dbo.accounts.acccode),
	customeraliasname=max(dbo.accounts.aliasname),
	salecatcode=max(dbo.saleledger.SaleCatCode)

FROM 
	saleledger,   
	saledetail,   
	accounts,   
	customer,   
	users,   
	item ,
	manufacturer

WHERE 
	(dbo.saleledger.headerno=:ai_headerno)AND
	( dbo.saleledger.headerinvno BETWEEN :ar_SInvCode AND :ar_LinvCode ) AND  
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode) AND  
	( dbo.saleledger.custcode IN (:ai_CustCode) ) AND 
	( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
	( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND 
	( dbo.saledetail.icode = dbo.item.icode) AND 
	( dbo.item.manfcode = dbo.manufacturer.manfcode) 

GROUP BY saleledger.saleinvcode, 
			saleledger.headerinvno,
         saleledger.date, 
			/*saleledger.headerno,*/
			saleledger.custcode, 
			saleledger.discperc, 
			saleledger.flatdisc, 
			saleledger.invgstperc1,
			saleledger.printwaranty,
			saleledger.printbatch,
			saleledger.misccharges, 
			saleledger.salestax, 
			saleledger.remarks,
			saleledger.custrefno, 
			saledetail.icode,
			saledetail.rowgroup, 
			saledetail.gcode, 
			item.name,
			manufacturer.manfcode,
			item.icode,
			item.printable, 
			accounts.name,
			dbo.users.username 

ORDER BY 
	dbo.saleledger.headerinvno,
	max(dbo.manufacturer.name),
	dbo.item.name,
	max(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL)

objects.name: compute_7
objects.visible: 1	if( printwaranty='Y' and  ai_PrintHeader =1 and headerno<>5,1,0)
objects.expression: 'WARRANTY UNDER SECTION 23(1) (i) OF THE DRUGS ACT 1976~r~n I  ' + f_ReportHeaderInfosale('ownername',  headerno )+ ' ' + 'being a person resident in Pakistan carrying on business at' +'  ' + f_ReportHeaderInfosale('address1',  headerno ) + '  ' + 'under the name of  ' + f_ReportHeaderInfosale('clientname',  headerno ) + ' being an importer/distributor/authorised agent of the drugs on this invoice, do hereby give this warranty that  the drugs on this invoice, as sold by me, do not contravene in any way the provisions of sections 23 of drug act 1976.'

objects.name: compute_6
objects.expression: 'FOR        '+f_ReportHeaderInfosale('clientname',  headerno )

objects.name: t_40
objects.text: NOTE: For dated items we must be informed four Months prior to expiry

objects.name: compute_3
objects.expression: f_StringPreferences('FullPageFooter')

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: f_StringPreferences('FullPageFooter2')

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: (  looseqty   *  (saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty )

objects.name: c_salestaxval
objects.expression: round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2)

objects.name: compute_9
objects.visible: 1	if(sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2)  for group 1)>0,1,0)
objects.expression: round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) + c_amount

objects.name: c_netamount
objects.expression: c_amount  *  ( 1 -  invdiscperc  * .01 )

objects.name: t_15
objects.text: I  N  V  O  I  C  E	if( headerno =2 or headerno=4,' S A L E S  T A X   I  N  V  O  I  C  E','I  N  V  O  I  C  E  /  C A S H   M E M O')

objects.name: compute_1
objects.expression: 'Page ' + page() + ' of ' + pageCount()

objects.name: c_itemdiscount
objects.expression: Round(( looseqty *   saleprice ) *  ( discperc *  .01 ) , 2)

objects.name: c_netrate
objects.expression: Round(((saleprice - itemflatdisc) * looseqty * (1- discperc * 0.01)) / if(looseqty > 0, looseqty, 1), 2)

objects.name: t_11
objects.visible: 1	if(sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for group 1)>0, 1, 0)

objects.name: t_9
objects.visible: 1	if(sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for group 1 )>0,1,0)

objects.name: c_companyname
objects.expression: f_ReportHeaderInfosale('clientname',  headerno )

objects.name: c_address1
objects.expression: f_ReportHeaderInfosale('address1',  headerno )

objects.name: compute_5
objects.expression: f_ReportHeaderInfosale('address2',  headerno )

objects.name: compute_8
objects.expression: 'Phone: ' + f_ReportHeaderInfosale('phone',  headerno) + '  Fax: '+f_ReportHeaderInfosale('fax',  headerno)

objects.name: c_totalitems
objects.expression: count(id for group 1)

objects.name: c_invdiscount
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_amount for group 1) * ( invdiscperc * .01) , 2)

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01),2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2)

objects.name: c_sumsalestaxval
objects.visible: 1	if(sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for group 1) > 0, 1, 0)
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for group 1)

objects.name: c_grosstotal
objects.expression: Sum((  looseqty   * ( saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) for group 1)

objects.name: compute_15
objects.visible: 1	if(sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for group 1 )>0,1,0)
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) + c_amount for group 1)

objects.name: compute_10
objects.expression: if(  balance < 0, 'Cr','' )

objects.name: c_balance
objects.expression: abs( balance )

objects.name: compute_14
objects.expression: if( Round(Sum (  c_netamount for group 1  ) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1 ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - discperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0) + balance < 0, 'Cr','' )

objects.name: compute_12
objects.expression: ABS(Round(Sum (  c_netamount for group 1 ) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1 ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1 )  *  (1 - discperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0) + balance)

objects.name: compute_11
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for group 1) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1 ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1 )  *  (1 - discperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) ,2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for group 1) , 0)

objects.name: c_indvsalestaxval
objects.expression: sum(c_salestaxval for group 1)

objects.name: t_24
objects.text: Net S. Tax inclusive Value Rs.

objects.name: c_totalsalextaxval
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - discperc * 0.01) ,2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for group 1) , 0)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for group 1 ) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1 ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1 )  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)

objects.name: compute_16
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for group 1 ) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1 ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1 )  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)

objects.name: compute_2
objects.visible: 1	if(sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for group 2) = 0, 0, 1)
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for group 2)

objects.name: c_manfgrosstotal
objects.expression: Sum((  looseqty   *  (saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) for group 2)

objects.name: compute_13
objects.visible: 1	if(sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for group 1 )>0,1,0)
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) + c_amount for group 2)
